title: Mohammed A. AlGhamdi (Board Director · CEO · FCIArb · Institution Builder) launches 'Institutions & Individuals' newsletter with a 4-part essay series prompted by Incorruptible
summary: Mohammed A. AlGhamdi is a board director and chief executive who works in corporate governance, and a Fellow of the Chartered Institute of Arbitrators. He announced the newsletter on LinkedIn.
blockquote:
I’m launching Institutions & Individuals, a new newsletter exploring how institutions shape, and are shaped by, human judgment.
  
The first essay begins a four-part series prompted by Eric Ries’s Incorruptible and asks a question of institutional continuity:
If corporate purpose is meant to endure, what should protect it?

source_urls.label: Essay 3 of the series (2026-10-24) — director judgment within the Saudi governance context
